releaseNotes:
Home Remote 1.4.0

- Refines the five existing remote styles and focused Settings. Short-window and large-text layouts were checked in the Android emulator.
- Improves saved-TV recovery while retaining pairing, profiles and preferences.
- Attempts automatic wake setup from information shared by the paired TV where supported, with clearer Retry and setup help. Existing manual setup is retained. TV settings, network and standby behavior still affect wake.
- Shows the current TV app/input and enables Play/Pause only when reliable state is available. Exact skips, episode actions and programme title/timeline information remain unavailable in this LG release.

Install this compatible update over the existing Home Remote app to keep local data. Do not uninstall or clear app data. Each phone keeps its own TV pairing. TV control stays local; update checks/downloads use the existing GitHub internet flow.

Help: https://remote.signum.ie/support/
Privacy information: https://remote.signum.ie/privacy/
